## Outcome

`showSelected` could filter the rows displayed in a visualization, but the histogram counts had already been calculated before the user clicked. I opened PR #343 to test whether `stat_bin` could recompute those counts in the browser.

## What I Did

- Started from [Issue #158](https://github.com/animint/animint2/issues/158) and added a failing browser test on August 12.
- Required the bar counts to change after selection while the bin boundaries stayed fixed.
- Began designing the raw-value and fixed-break data that the browser implementation would need.
- Continued review work on PR #336 and PR #261 while the proof of concept was taking shape.

## Learnings

Filtering precomputed bars was not enough because the statistic itself depended on the selected rows. Fixed breaks were also necessary; otherwise both the counts and the bin grid could change at the same time.

## Challenges / Notes

This was still a proof of concept. The complete JavaScript path, test cleanup, and coverage work continued into Final Submission, and the result was not a general system for every ggplot statistic.

## Next Week Targets

Complete the JavaScript path, stabilize the tests, finish the multiline-text review, and prepare the final report.
